_comment: The shopping list, machine-readable. Binaries are NOT committed — a 2K PBR
set is 5-15MB and ten of them would dwarf the repo. This manifest is the
source of truth; render/fetch_assets.py downloads against it into
render/assets/<category>/<id>/ (gitignored), and reports precisely what is
missing so the list doubles as a manual shopping list.
Everything here is CC0 (public domain, no attribution required) from
ambientCG and Poly Haven. Nothing is conditioned on a living artist's work,
per the art direction's standing rule.
ID ACCURACY: the numeric ids below are best-effort. ambientCG numbers its
materials (Wood067, Ground037) and the exact number for a given look is not
something to take on trust — `search` on each entry is what actually matters.
fetch_assets.py verifies what it got and names anything that 404s, so a
wrong id fails loudly instead of silently substituting the wrong surface.

materials.search: planks / wood — smooth, pale, tight grain
materials.why: The turned figurine's base and any bare carved wood. Wants FINE grain: coarse planking at figurine scale reads as a floor, not a carving.

materials.search: wood — visible grain under a finish
materials.why: The paint recipe's substrate. Grain showing THROUGH colour is the single detail that separates 'painted wood' from 'plastic'.

materials.search: ground / grass — patchy, dry, not a manicured lawn
materials.why: Replaces the procedural mottle on the valley floor. Biggest single upgrade in the town frame — flat green is the loudest CG tell we have.
Second ground tone so the valley isn't one surface repeated. Two grounds blended kills visible tiling at overlook distance.
The road. Wants to look maintained-by-a-county, not resurfaced last week.
Driveways and shoulders. The Dale reference plate has a gravel path doing a lot of quiet work.
The overlook ledge when the watchers return to frame.
The civic block, the one larger mass in the town.
Parking lot, kerbs, the water tower's footings.

materials.search: fabric / burlap — coarse weave, visible thread
materials.why: Figurine coats. The Dale plate's jacket weave is exactly this, and it is most of why that plate reads as carved-and-dressed.

hdris.search: partly cloudy day sky, sun fairly high
hdris.why: The day palette variant. A captured sky gives believable soft fill for free — the thing two lamps cannot fake.

hdris.search: low warm sun, long light, autumn-adjacent
hdris.why: The dusk variant — the reference plates' hour.
The night variant, replacing the flat dark dome currently standing in for one.
